# Tests that have never passed in this repository.
#
# Checked by .github/scripts/check-test-baseline.php, which compares the exact set
# of failing tests against this list. A failure that is not listed here fails the
# build as a regression; an entry here that starts passing also fails the build, so
# that this file cannot silently rot.
#
# All 13 predate the Blade -> Inertia migration. Twelve throw BadMethodCallException
# because the models import Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory but
# never apply the trait in the class body (Wallet, Order, SupportTicket), or have
# neither trait nor factory (Category) — so Model::factory() does not exist. Fixing
# those four models retires most of this list in one go.
#
# Format: one FQCN::method per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
